identite.quote: **Account and profile** We collect your mobile phone number and/or email address as the login credentials for your account and assign a user identification number to your account. If you choose to register or log in via external third-party services, such as Facebook or Google, you agree we may collect your profile photo, username, and/or email address associated with the relevant third-party service provider. We also collect information in your profile, account settings and preferences in your Temu account. We also collect your country/region.
identite.purpose: Création et maintenance du compte, sécurité du compte, personnalisation de l'expérience utilisateur.

contact.quote: **Account and profile** We collect your mobile phone number and/or email address as the login credentials for your account [...] We also collect your shipping address (e.g., city, state, country/region, zip code), recipient contact information (e.g., name, mobile phone number), and designated package collection point (e.g., city, state, country/region, zip code) in countries where we enable this functionality.
contact.purpose: Gestion des commandes, livraison, communication avec l'utilisateur et support client.

compte_auth.quote: **Account and profile** We collect your mobile phone number and/or email address as the login credentials for your account and assign a user identification number to your account. If you choose to register or log in via external third-party services, such as Facebook or Google, you agree we may collect your profile photo, username, and/or email address associated with the relevant third-party service provider.
compte_auth.purpose: Authentification et sécurité du compte utilisateur.

paiement.quote: **Purchases** We collect data related to your orders on the Service (e.g., transaction ID, transaction history, product identification number), payment information required to complete the transaction (e.g., payment card number or other third-party payment information required for payment, billing address),
paiement.purpose: Traitement des paiements, prévention de la fraude et gestion des litiges.

localisation.quote: **General location data** We collect your approximate location data based on your technical information (e.g., IP address). [...] We also collect your shipping address (e.g., city, state, country/region, zip code), [...] and locate the geographical coordinates of the address you have provided to us (e.g., Google maps), to easily direct you to the most appropriate package collection point for deliveries in countries where we enable this functionality.
localisation.purpose: Livraison des commandes et personnalisation de l'expérience utilisateur.

appareil_technique.quote: **Device data** We collect personal information about the device you use to access the Service, such as device model, operating system information, internet service provider, language settings, unique identifiers (e.g., identifiers used for advertising purposes where permitted by law). **Data collected via cookies and similar technologies** We collect information via cookies and similar technologies stored on your device.
appareil_technique.purpose: Amélioration de l'expérience utilisateur, personnalisation, publicité ciblée et prévention de la fraude.

usage_comportement.quote: **Service usage information** We collect personal information about your interactions with the Service, including the source from which you arrived at our pages, the pages you viewed, other interactions with the Service (e.g., your browsing history, searching and purchasing history), the items in your shopping cart and whether you opened our emails or clicked on the links within our emails.
usage_comportement.purpose: Personnalisation de l'expérience, publicité ciblée et amélioration du service.

contenus_utilisateur.quote: **User-generated content** When you provide any content (e.g., images, videos, or text) to leave product reviews and ratings, provide images to search for items, or provide images or text to customise products, we collect this information and its associated metadata to support and enable your use of the Service.
contenus_utilisateur.purpose: Support et activation des fonctionnalités de la plateforme (avis, personnalisation, recherche).

communications.quote: **Customer support activity** When you communicate with our customer service team through our customer support functions in the mobile application/on the website, either with a customer service agent or with our virtual assistant (via the chatbot or hotline), through social media, or any other means, we will collect your communication history with us which includes any text, images, video, audio, or supporting documents exchanged between us. **Chats with merchandise partners** When you chat with merchandise partners on Temu, we collect your chat communications and other related information.
communications.purpose: Support client, gestion des litiges et amélioration du service.

donnees_tiers.quote: **Information from third-party sources** To the extent permitted by applicable laws, we may receive and collect your personal information from other third-party sources, such as: **Data providers** We receive and collect your personal information, such as identity verification information and fraud prevention risk-scoring, from information services to help us detect fraud regarding payments, prevent unauthorized transactions, and safeguard the Service. **Marketing and advertising partners** We receive and collect your personal information from our marketing and advertising partners [...] **Our payment processors** We obtain your personal information from our third-party payment processors [...] **Merchandise partners and their business partners** We collect publicly available information about you from our merchandise partners and/or their business partners, such as information about your purchases, use of products, ratings and reviews.
donnees_tiers.purpose: Prévention de la fraude, marketing, traitement des paiements et amélioration du service.

donnees_sensibles.quote: **Customer support activity** When submitting a complaint or request through our customer support functions, you may choose to provide documentation, information, or photographs including health details, medical treatments, tests, reports, medications or other evidence for product-related injuries or health impacts.
donnees_sensibles.purpose: Gestion des réclamations et support client.
donnees_sensibles.purpose_quote: When submitting a complaint or request through our customer support functions, you may choose to provide documentation, information, or photographs including health details, medical treatments, tests, reports, medications or other evidence for product-related injuries or health impacts.

mineurs.quote: Individuals under 18 and at least 13 years of age are only permitted to use our Service through an account owned by a parent or legal guardian with their appropriate permission and under their direct supervision. Individuals under 13 years of age are not permitted to use Temu or the Service.
mineurs.purpose: Conformité légale et protection des mineurs.

legal_bases.data: identite, contact, compte_auth, paiement, localisation, appareil_technique, usage_comportement
legal_bases.quote:
**Declining to provide information**
We need to collect your personal information to provide certain services. If you do not provide the information we require to provide the Service, we cannot provide the Service.

**Legal claims based on your consent**
In some cases, we may specifically ask for your consent to collect, use, or share your personal information, where required by applicable U.S. laws.

**Cookies and similar technologies**
We collect information via cookies and similar technologies stored on your device. These cookies are either necessary and required to provide our Service (for example, the cookies we use to display products relevant to your language and location) or optional (for example, the cookies used to track and measure the advertisements shown to you).

**How and Why We Use Your Information**
We use your personal information to prevent, detect, investigate, and respond to fraud, unauthorized access to or use of the Service, violations of the Terms of Use and other Temu policies, or other misconduct.

**Fraud prevention and security**
We use your personal information to prevent, detect, investigate, and respond to fraud, unauthorized access to or use of the Service, violations of the Terms of Use and other Temu policies, or other misconduct.

**Compliance, legal obligations and protection**
We may use your personal information for compliance purposes and to comply with applicable U.S. laws, including lawful requests, and legal processes (e.g., responding to subpoenas or requests from U.S. government or regulatory authorities); to comply with legal requirements of government entities (e.g., U.S. Customs), which may release such information pursuant to rules and regulations governing the public disclosure of government data;

**Orders and delivery of products and services**
We use your personal information to receive and process orders, deliver products and services, process payments, communicate with you regarding orders, products, services, and promotional offers, and facilitate order disputes, refunds and/or returns of your orders.

countries.quote: Data of Temu’s U.S. users will be stored in the infrastructure of cloud service providers in the U.S.

hosting.quote: Data of Temu’s U.S. users will be stored in the infrastructure of cloud service providers in the U.S.

transfers.quote: Data of Temu’s U.S. users will be stored in the infrastructure of cloud service providers in the U.S. As a global one-stop shopping destination, Temu may need to engage and share your personal information to various parties, including our service providers, as described in the “How and Why We Share Your Information” section. These parties may be located in countries or jurisdictions that have data protection laws that are different in some aspects from the laws of the country or jurisdiction in which you reside.

recipients.name: Digital Advertising Alliance (DAA)
recipients.quote: In providing interest-based advertising, we follow the Self-Regulatory Principles for Online Behavioral Advertising as set forth by the Digital Advertising Alliance (DAA), which is an advocacy organization for responsible digital marketing and consumer privacy.

recipients.name: merchandise partners
recipients.quote: **Merchandise partners** We may share your personal information with the merchandise partners related to the product reviews you leave, the return or refund reasons you request a return or refund, and customization information for customized/personalized items.

recipients.name: logistics service providers
recipients.quote: **Logistics service providers**, from whom we may collect your certain information, such as package information, delivery progress, proof of delivery, and delivery address, and make this information available to you within your account, to effectively fulfill your order.

recipients.name: payment processors
recipients.quote: **Our payment processors** We obtain your personal information from our third-party payment processors who help us process transactions, provide our Service, and prevent fraudulent or illegal activity.

recipients.name: third-party advertising partners
recipients.quote: **Advertising and analytics partners** We may share your personal information with third-party advertising, marketing, and analytics companies for the interest-based advertising and analytics purposes described in our Cookies and Similar Technologies Policy.

signals.quote: We, our service providers, and our third-party advertising partners may collect and use your personal information for interest-based advertising purposes.
